fact: Failure to serve a penalty during a pit stop. Infringment Breach of Article 54.4 (c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
reason: Car 27 entered the pits having received a 5 second penalty previously. The pit stop was observed on multiple angles of video by the FIA Race Operations Centre and subsequently was checked by the Stewards and the team failed to serve the full 5 seconds penalty before working on the car.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Infringement Car 27 Failure To Serve A Penalty
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
